data.name: Crimson Reflection
data.detailed_description:
“I’ll save you… so we can stay together… forever, okay?”

The remastered edition of the yandere suspense novel game Crimson Reflection, first released in 2013, is finally here.

The story begins when the protagonist, Kazuma Ayaori, kills his own lover—giving birth to a twisted drama of love and madness.

Faced with Asana’s dangerously obsessive affection, what choice will Kazuma make?

Madness, deception, jealousy, obsession, despair, hatred—and regret.

Every emotion collides, driving the incident toward an unforeseen conclusion.

Story

One summer day, Kazuma Ayaori kills his lover, Rin Nasukawa.

Thrown into confusion, Kazuma turns to his childhood friend Asana Shinokura for help.

As panic overwhelms him, Asana proposes that they share the secret. Together, they fabricate alibis, and the truth of the crime disappears into the darkness.

But once the gears of fate have gone mad, they will never grant the two a peaceful everyday life again…

Confronted with Asana’s excessively twisted love, what decision will Kazuma make?

Madness, deception, jealousy, obsession, despair, hatred—and regret.

All emotions intertwine, pulling the incident toward an unexpected ending.

“I don’t need her anymore—as long as tomorrow is with you.”

Crimson Reflection—a yandere suspense novel game.

The most extreme story ever told, woven from dense madness and regret.

Characters

Kazuma Ayaori

The protagonist of the story.

Asana Shinokura CV: Sora Aotsuki

Kazuma’s childhood friend.

She harbored deep romantic feelings for him since childhood, yet their closeness prevented them from becoming lovers.

After the incident, her overwhelming love finally reveals its true form.

Mikage Toyomi CV: Nashinomarimo

Kazuma’s classmate. Seen by others as a model student—polite and academically excellent.

That is merely her public face.

Raised in a complicated family environment, she grew up without knowing love.

Rin Nasukawa CV: Hisui

One year older than Kazuma and his senior.

After a certain incident, she becomes Kazuma’s girlfriend—but…

Detective Ashiya CV: Yoshino Ryutaro

An inspector from the Akagano Police Department.

Usually sloppy in demeanor, yet a seasoned detective who has never let a suspect escape in a case he handled.

“I don’t need her—as long as tomorrow is with you.”

Content Guidelines

Video uploads and live streaming using this title on platforms such as YouTube are officially permitted, regardless of whether they are for commercial or non-commercial purposes.

However, please refrain from posting or streaming content that simply broadcasts the game without adding your own commentary or gameplay audio.

The use of this title in members-only or restricted content, including YouTube Membership videos and streams, is also officially permitted.

Notice

The quality of the translations may not be fully sufficient.
Thank you for your understanding.

data.short_description: The story begins the moment he kills his lover. Kazuma is driven into a corner by Asana’s obsessive love. Madness, jealousy, obsession, deception, and regret collide— plunging the case toward an unpredictable end. A yandere suspense novel of intense love and insanity: Crimson Reflection.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent AMD processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9.0c compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent AMD processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9.0c or higher compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
